# luca_smoke

Minimal LucaSystem game root for the AetherLuca provider tests.

- `files/SCRIPT.PAK` — probe marker; `00_smoke` drives the layer pipeline
  (STARTUP vars, INIT, IMAGELOAD at (100,50), PRIORITY, DRAW, END).
- `files/image/SMOKE.PAK` — id_base 1, one 64x48 CZ3: red left half,
  blue right half.

Expected frame: the 1920x1080 compositor canvas with the CZ3 blitted
at (100, 50).

Generated by `cargo run -p luca_runtime --bin gen-smoke-fixture <dir>`
from the AetherLuca repository (luca_formats builders).
